opinion.reasoning: The late synthetic brief supports staying constructive on tech, but not chasing the broad tape: Nasdaq made a fresh intraday high while the S&P faded from the open and breadth tightened, so the rally is still selective. The Hormuz story is better sourced than the 07:00 brief because Reuters-style confirmation now backs Iran's reopening offer, but Trump's UN timeline pushes peace beyond an immediate catalyst and keeps oil/geopolitical risk two-sided. META remains the cleanest event setup into Connect, yet the move already includes Monday's 11% Muse rerating and a single-source Jefferies target hike, so I would wait for Connect details before upgrading to lean-long.
opinion.catalyst: Meta Connect confirms Muse adoption or agentic commerce traction while oil and yields keep easing without a renewed Iran escalation.
opinion.risk: A disappointing Connect event, failed Hormuz diplomacy, oil rebound, or hawkish Fed signal would expose the rally's narrow leadership and unwind the tech bid.
